query: Which lab/model currently has the highest score on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index as of today, and what is that score? Distinguish clearly between Anthropic Claude Fable 5 (reportedly launched at #1 with 64.9), Claude Opus 4.8 (reportedly #1 at ~55.7% on BenchLM mirror), and OpenAI GPT-5.5. Account for the fact that Fable 5 was suspended June 12 and redeployed July 1, 2026, and reconcile whether the top index score is 64.9 (Fable 5) or ~55.7% (Opus 4.8), including scale/normalization differences across mirrors.
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the key finding:

**The "64.9 vs ~55.7%" is a false dichotomy** — they're different methodology versions on different scales measuring different models, and **neither is the current top score.**

- **64.9** = Fable 5's launch score (June 9) under the now-**retired v4.0** methodology.
- **~55.7%** = Opus 4.8 on the **BenchLM percentage mirror** — where Opus 4.8 is **not #1** (the "Opus 4.8 #1 at 55.7%" claim is a conflation).
- **Current leader (July 25, 2026):** an **Anthropic Claude model at ~60 points / ~60%** — Claude Opus 5 (60.7%) or Claude Fable 5-with-fallback (59.9%/60), with GPT-5.6 Sol second at ~58.9%.

Three sources of confusion reconciled: (1) **v4.0→v4.1 methodology change** (June 15) dropped Fable 5 from 64.9 to 60; (2) **scale differences** — native AA points vs BenchLM percentages vs GDPval Elo (human=1000); (3) the **June 12 suspension / July 1 redeployment** added a safety classifier that reroutes tasks to the weaker Opus 4.8 fallback (~70% debugging-score collapse), which is why the live entry is labeled "Fable 5 (with Opus 4.8 fallback)."

key_facts: Claude Fable 5 launched June 9, 2026 at #1 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with a score of 64.9 under the (now retired) v4.0 methodology, ~5 points ahead of the best non-Anthropic model (then GPT-5.5).

Index v4.1 was published June 15, 2026, shifting toward agentic workloads (removed saturated IFBench; upgraded Terminal-Bench 2.1, tau3-Bench Banking, and GDPval-AA v2 weighted at 20%), re-scoring Fable 5 down to 60 on the native point scale.
The 64.9 figure is against a retired methodology; under v4.1 Fable 5 = 60, Claude Opus 4.8 (max) = 56, GPT-5.5 (xhigh) = 55 on the native point scale.
BenchLM.ai mirror (July 25, 2026, percentage scale, display-only reference): Claude Opus 5 60.7%, Claude Fable 5 59.9%, GPT-5.6 Sol 58.9%, Claude Opus 4.8 55.7%, GPT-5.5 54.8%.
The ~55.7% figure is Claude Opus 4.8 on the BenchLM percentage mirror; Opus 4.8 is NOT the #1 model there, so the claim 'Opus 4.8 #1 at ~55.7%' is a conflation/error.

Fable 5 was suspended June 12, 2026 due to US Commerce Dept export controls (triggered by an Amazon report on safeguard bypass) and redeployed July 1, 2026 after controls lifted June 30, with a stricter cybersecurity safety classifier.

Post-redeployment the safety classifier reroutes many tasks to the weaker Opus 4.8 fallback, causing reported ~70% drops on debugging; the leaderboard entry is labeled 'Claude Fable 5 (with Opus 4.8 fallback).'
GDPval-AA v2 (highest-weighted v4.1 component) uses an Elo scale with human performance = 1000: Claude Fable 5 (with fallback) 1818, Claude Opus 4.8 1638, GPT-5.5 (xhigh) 1531.
The current index leader as of July 25, 2026 is an Anthropic Claude model in the ~60 point / ~60% range; GPT (5.6 Sol) is second at ~58.9%. Neither 64.9 nor ~55.7% is the current top figure.
March 2026 (earlier vintage): top was 57/57 shared by Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview and GPT-5.4 (xhigh); Claude Opus 4.6 was 53 — GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.8 had not yet appeared.
